semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Proteco provides industrial temperature control systems crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Proteco (Shanghai) Refrigeration Technology Equipment Co., Ltd. specializes in industrial temperature control systems designed for semiconductor manufacturing. Their systems offer precise temperature control over a wide range, essential for processes involving jacketed reaction vessels and other demanding applications.
capabilities: Closed system technology preventing oxidation and contamination
Wide temperature control range from -120℃ to 350℃
Single media circulation method for precise temperature control
Modular control system for expandable parameters like flow rate
technical_expertise: Process control for exothermic and endothermic reactions
